name: ContentCollab: 5xx share per route above 2% over 5 minutes
message:
More than {{threshold}} of the requests to {{route.name}} answered 5xx in the last 5 minutes (now {{value}}).

Find the failing requests: Logs, `@http.route:{{route.name}} @http.status_code:5*`, then follow one `@http.request_id` through the log. Check `kubectl -n contentcollab get pods` and `kubectl -n contentcollab logs deploy/api`; /health answers 503 when PostgreSQL or Redis is down.
